It means taking a leap or one next step. Transform the thin hand-drawn strokes into a bold, thick, clean, sculptural black icon. The two marks and arrow must stay distinct and immediately legible at small app-icon size. Pure opaque WHITE edge-to-edge background. BLACK symbol with only restrained neutral gray highlights and subtle soft contact shadows for depth. No colored tint, no green, no gradients on the background, no text, no letters, no numbering, no outline of a phone, no icon tile border, no mockup or grid. Balanced centered arrangement fills around 72% of the square with generous uniform white padding; all objects fully visible. Professional minimal app icon, controlled soft studio lighting from upper left, clear silhouette, premium rather than ornamental. VARIANT A — ROUNDED MATTE SCULPTURE. The arrow is a very thick solid rounded beam, smoothly arches across the upper half and ends in a compact unmistakable broad arrowhead. Gentle bevels, satin matte black ceramic finish, deep black dominant frontal surfaces, modest real extrusion depth. Both landing marks are thick elliptical black rings with large white holes, almost pillowy edges but firm geometry. The rings lie flat on the implied white plane. Friendly, sturdy, simple, unified thickness. Camera is nearly frontal with only enough elevation to reveal subtle thickness. No thin shaft, no wire-like forms.
